title: GriefPrevention Transfer All Claims
description: Easily transfer all claims to another player!
body:
A simple plugin that allows server admins to transfer all claims of a player to another  player.

Command: ```/transferallclaims <from> <to>```
Example:
- ```/transferallclaims Notch Kyrobi```
- ```/transferallclaims 069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5 Kyrobi```
- ```/transferallclaims 069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5 320f24f7-7f2b-4c09-954f-d1c27613a0ff```

Permission: ```transferallclaims.use```

**Why Use This**
GriefPrevention does not offer a command to transfer all claims in bulk. This is useful for server admins who wish to transfer every claim to a new account if the user's old account is inaccessible or they simply wish to have it moved to a new account.

**Requirements**
- GriefPrevention plugin
